name: Vaðlaheiðargöng tunnel
law: Vaðlaheiðargöng hf.'s price list in force from 2026-03-02, single trips: vehicles of 3.5-7.5 t ISK 3087, of 7.5 t and over ISK 6505, each direction (11% VAT included).
